batch.hypothesis: Editor memory M2. A released language server program frees its per-version tables (M2a) and its NewProgram (M2b, Rc<NewProgram>). Parse task Rc cycles are freed, and watch frees the old program after its status line (repair 1). Large frees on the LSP dispatch thread wait until the answer is sent (gostd::local::drop_later), and module resolutions are shared, not copied (repair 2). Long editor sessions grow 0.72 MiB/edit on query-core (R131 1.40) and 0.56 on hono (R131 1.13), under the gate limit of 1.00; effect long is 1.66 (R131 about 3.1). Output byte-identical to R131 and to tsgo at 52168999f3dc, 0 editor answer differences. No protected loss (roster carried forward from R131).
